pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges. The relative spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the neck and decreases in size toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented negative space forming a continuous topological network with distinct tri-junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with some narrowing toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck ridge exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) localized on the dorsal and lateral neck and shoulder regions.
